titles.romaji: Hontou ni Atta Hitozuma Furin Kokuhaku
titles.native: 本当にあった人妻不倫告白

description:
Motomoura Touko has been a housewife for six years, until now still has no children and his husband works as an employee. Since childhood, Motomoura had seen her own mother cheating at night. Since then it was, her began to experience physical changes and easily aroused into adulthood. Until finally he found the right guy...

(Source: Translated and Edited from Nekopoi)
